name: Balcony
description: An airy open-air verandah overlooking the tranquil residential streets of Jabalpur. Potted hibiscus, money plants, and flowering bougainvillea line the terracotta railing, with a comfortable cane armchair inviting you to sit and feel the breeze.

ambience.morning: Crisp, invigorating morning air sweeps across the terrace with the scent of night-blooming jasmine and damp earth. Distant temple bells and morning birds chime gently.
ambience.afternoon: A warm afternoon breeze rustles the lush leaves in the planters. The shaded cane chair provides a breezy vantage point over the quiet neighborhood.
ambience.evening: The golden hour sky turns lavender and amber over the Jabalpur rooftops. Evening street murmurs and the faint, nostalgic aroma of roasted corn drift up from below.
ambience.night: Cool night air brings the soothing calm of Jabalpur under the stars. Gentle crickets chirp softly among the potted foliage as petrichor rises from the evening-watered soil.
